healthBenefits.title: Rich in Antioxidants
healthBenefits.text: Cime di rapa are packed with vitamins A and C, powerful antioxidants that help protect cells from oxidative stress and support the immune system.

healthBenefits.title: Bone Health
healthBenefits.text: High in calcium and vitamin K, cime di rapa contribute to strong bones and proper blood clotting. One serving provides a significant portion of daily calcium needs.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil is rich in oleic acid and polyphenols, which help reduce LDL cholesterol and inflammation. The monounsaturated fats in this dish support cardiovascular health.

healthBenefits.title: High in Fibre
healthBenefits.text: With over 5g of dietary fibre per serving, this dish supports healthy digestion and helps maintain stable blood sugar levels after meals.

healthBenefits.title: Anti-inflammatory Properties
healthBenefits.text: Garlic and chili pepper contain allicin and capsaicin, natural compounds with anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties that have been used in Mediterranean folk medicine for centuries.

healthBenefits.title: Iron & Energy
healthBenefits.text: The combination of iron from the greens and complex carbohydrates from durum wheat pasta provides sustained energy. Vitamin C from the rapa enhances iron absorption.
